```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, dpi = 150, fig.width = 10)
source("settings.R")
library(ggplot2)
library(LSX)

load(file.path(DIR_RESULT, "/awe/gmm-lss.rda"))
```

```{r}
boxplot(lss ~ topic, dat, las = 2)
```

```{r}
boxplot(lss ~ country, dat, las = 2)
```

```{r}
smo <- smooth_lss(dat, "lss", group = "country", engine = "locfit")
ggplot(smo, aes(date, fit, color = country)) +
  geom_line()
```

```{r}
smo <- smooth_lss(subset(dat, topic == "topic32"), "lss", group = "country", engine = "locfit")
ggplot(smo, aes(date, fit, color = country)) +
  geom_line()
```
